Package index

Start here

The drivers. Each walks an EPA flowchart, selects the method the manual directs, and records why.

tox_test() summary(<tox_test>) as.data.frame(<tox_test>)
Run the EPA hypothesis-testing analysis
lc50() summary(<tox_lc50>) as.data.frame(<tox_lc50>)
Estimate a median lethal concentration
decisions()
Extract the decision trail

Preparing data

The input contract and the transformations every method begins with.

tox_data() print(<tox_data>) summary(<tox_data>) as.data.frame(<tox_data>)
Prepare toxicity test data for analysis
arcsine_sqrt()
Arc sine square root transformation
inv_arcsine_sqrt()
Back-transform an arc sine square root value
abbott()
Abbott's correction for control response
smooth_monotone()
Smooth a sequence to be monotone
is_monotone()
Is a sequence monotone?

Assumptions and sensitivity

The tests that decide which branch of the hypothesis-testing flowchart is taken, and the measures of how sensitive the test was.

epa_normality()
Test the normality assumption
epa_variance()
Test the homogeneity of variance assumption
msd()
Minimum significant difference
pmsd()
Percent minimum significant difference

Hypothesis tests

The tests the flowchart can select. williams() is an extension rather than an EPA method and is never selected automatically.

dunnett()
Dunnett's procedure
bonferroni_t()
The t test with Bonferroni's adjustment
dunn_sidak_t()
The t test with Dunn-Sidak's adjustment
welch_t()
Welch's t test against the control
steel()
Steel's Many-One Rank Test
wilcoxon_rank_sum()
Wilcoxon Rank Sum Test with Bonferroni's adjustment
fisher_exact()
Fisher's Exact Test
williams()
Williams' test

Point estimation

Median lethal concentrations from the Figure 6 flowchart, and inhibition concentrations by linear interpolation.

graphical_lc50()
Estimate the LC50 by the graphical method
spearman_karber()
Estimate the LC50 by the Spearman-Karber method
trimmed_spearman_karber()
Estimate the LC50 by the trimmed Spearman-Karber method
probit_lc()
Estimate lethal concentrations by the probit method
icp()
Estimate an inhibition concentration by linear interpolation

ceriodaphnia_m1
Ceriodaphnia dubia reproduction, EPA Table M.1
acute_table20

epa_pmsd_bounds
EPA variability criteria for sublethal endpoints
